name: HeyGen MCP and API
description: Generates avatar videos, prompt-to-video scenes, video translations and short clips from AI agents and apps, through HeyGen's hosted MCP server, REST API, or CLI.

skills.name: Video Agent
skills.description: Turns a prompt into a finished video, with the agent handling script, avatar selection, scene composition, and rendering.

skills.name: Avatar Video
skills.description: Creates a lip-synced video in which a HeyGen avatar or an image speaks your script or audio track.

skills.name: Video Translation
skills.description: Translates a video into one or more target languages with voice cloning and lip-sync, in speed or precision mode.

skills.name: AI Clipping
skills.description: Cuts a long video into short clips by picking highlights from its spoken dialogue, as an asynchronous job.

skills.name: Speech Generation
skills.description: Generates speech audio from a HeyGen voice clone in your workspace, returning a WAV file or another requested format.
